svg.title: The five findings, in the order to deal with them
svg.desc: One card per finding, ranked. The chips on the right are the phases, risks and flows each one is holding up, and every one of them is clickable. The severity is on the chip; what the finding actually is, and why it carries that status, is one click away rather than in a paragraph here.
